```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
```

`DSEMr` supports binary and ordinal outcomes and dynamic IRT indicators via
latent-response probit data augmentation with Mplus-compatible threshold sign
conventions (`u$1 = -nu`), supporting both observed categorical autoregression
and single- or two-level dynamic IRT (Mplus Examples 6.27 and 9.35).

```{r}
library(DSEMr)

dat_bin <- simulate_dsem(
  n = 100, intercept = 0.2, ar = 0.45, sigma = 1,
  family = "binary", seed = 627
)
m_bin <- dsem_model("y ~ lag(y, 1)", family = "binary", time = "time")
fit_bin <- dsem(m_bin, dat_bin, chains = 2, iter = 300, warmup = 150, seed = 627)
coef(fit_bin)
```

Dynamic binary IRT with fixed factor innovation variance (`f@1`) and free item
loadings compiles directly from Mplus syntax (`VARIABLE: CATEGORICAL = u1-u4;`)
or `lavaan` syntax with `categorical = c("u1", "u2", "u3", "u4")`.
